//: Non-secret production configuration. Secrets come from environment variables: ConnectionStrings__Default, Jwt__SigningKey, Stripe__SecretKey, Stripe__WebhookSecret. Never add them to this file — it is committed.
//AllowedHosts: Rejects requests whose Host header is anything else, which blocks host-header injection and stops the app answering on an unexpected name.

Jwt.//Issuer: The API's own origin. Tokens are rejected if this does not match what signed them, so changing it invalidates every issued token.

//Cors: The site and the API share an origin, so the browser never makes a cross-origin request and this policy never fires. It is listed anyway: the startup check requires it, and it is what makes the deployment correct rather than accidentally safe if the site ever moves to its own host.
